people.name: Ahimelech
people.line: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.
translations.bsb: Then Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the ark of God.” (For at that time it was with the Israelites.)
translations.kjv: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And Saul said unto Ahijah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was there at that time with the children of Israel.
